LESSON: SUBTRACTION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Subtraction

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Subtraction
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. subtract with and without regrouping

SECTION 3: PICTURES

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-039.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 39]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-105.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 105]]

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-107.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 107]]

SECTION 4: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Subtraction

Teach
• Subtraction finds what is left or the difference.

Worked example
• 48 − 23 = 25
• 52 − 18 = 34
• KSh 100 − KSh 35 = KSh 65

Try this
• 67 − 21
• 80 − 46
• (Check later: 46; 34)


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• 48 − 23 = 25
• 52 − 18 = 34

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve five subtraction questions showing working.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Write change problems using shillings.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Regroup when ones are not enough.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
